name: cineroll
//dependencies: jose is declared here ONLY to control npm hoisting. Vercel bundles the backend function from the ROOT node_modules and drops anything nested under backend/node_modules. next-auth pulls jose@6 (ESM-only), which would take the root slot and force the backend's CommonJS jose@5 to nest — where Vercel silently omits it, producing 'Cannot find module jose' on every backend route. Pinning v5 here gives it the root slot; @auth/core keeps its v6 nested, which is fine because Next.js bundles the frontend at build time instead of resolving at runtime. Do not remove without running scripts/check-build-inputs.mjs.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=packages/types && npm run type-check --workspace=backend && npm run type-check --workspace=frontend
